import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    z = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    k = 0  # 0 outside, 1 inside parentheses
    count = 0
    outside_max = 0
    inside_words = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = z[i]
        i += 1
        if c == '_':
            if k == 0:
                if count > outside_max:
                    outside_max = count
            else:
                if count > 0:
                    inside_words += 1
            count = 0
        elif c == '(':
            k = 1
            if count > outside_max:
                outside_max = count
            count = 0
        elif c == ')':
            k = 0
            if count > 0:
                inside_words += 1
            count = 0
        else:
            count += 1
    if k == 0 and count > outside_max:
        outside_max = count
    print(outside_max, inside_words)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
